notes.title: Content Update - New cards! - April 24 2022
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s been a while since I’ve last released an update to the playtest. I’m only able to work on this project part-time, and other responsibilities have kept me somewhat busy for the last few months. I’ll be trying to get a lot more content out now. 

As ever, there will likely be many bugs despite my best efforts with so many new cards. I appreciate the help of the playtesters in identifying these bugs.

With that being said, this update brings in 13 new cards and a few keywords to add some more variety to the gameplay. All of these cards have an increased chance of appearing in card rewards for this update, so that they're easier to find and test.

[list]
[*] Absolute Focus (Ability)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/342120aae525bb87d567bf772624727ddcfdb9a2.png[/img]
The [b]range [/b]status effect increases the attack range of all ranged attacks by just 1, and has a duration.
[b]Disarmed [/b]prevents you from making any melee attacks. Some of the melee attacks that also have movement may still work, but you will not be able to do any melee damage.

[*]Card cascade (Ranged Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/a197ff0d043af1c06c42dc69cb8f34b22d1fabdc.png[/img]

[*] Double Step (Move)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/63ba341a10baa84da38e51dc9e1eb449718f5401.png[/img]
I'm hoping to have more cards like this one that add cards to your hand, or manipulate the hand in interesting ways.

[*] Step (Move)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/21b2c926b3f9a41b03ab4e808149c725f1190f43.png[/img]
[b]Vanishing [/b]cards will disappear after being discarded at the end of your turn, which means you only have one opportunity to play them.

[*]Explosive Disposal (Ranged Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/bd0f46e611ea07e86aed02251d293a39b6aaab41.png[/img]
This card only works in one direction, behind you. I'm not sure if a keyword is necessary to make this directional limitation more clear.

[*]Fatigue (Ability)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/2304b2a48260debd954c6f03210b74592961ca89.png[/img]

[*]Final Slice (Melee Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/3bff4d28953866827e1c5484c6bff724c1795141.png[/img]
[b]Spectral [/b]movement allows you to move through (but not remain inside) enemies, but not obstacles. I’m interested to see how this mechanic feels to use.
After playing this card, your turn is forcibly ended. I may add a keyword for this type of behavior in the future.

[*]Flurry of blows (Melee Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/41c20bf70c62eb336141753527a52a5742041ea3.png[/img]
This card is meant to quickly scale up in damage with significant amounts of strength. Right now there aren’t as many sources of strength as I’d like, which makes this card much less effective than it could be. I will certainly be adding more sources of strength gain, such as cards, in the future.

[*]Reckless Bravado (Move)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/dfa940ee6b45966a1929138778199b2f36e5078f.png[/img]
Charge: move forward. For this card, you move the maximum amount possible, you don't get to choose how far to move (to make this clear, the description omits the words "up to"). It also provides one power, at the cost of being immobile for the rest of your turn.

[*]Rolling Dagger (Move/Ranged Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/38e2d8091918f32d818ae0b3e15b2dc6917e2de9.png[/img]
Sidestep: move to either side. 
This card is considered a movement card because its selectable range (the range a player uses when playing the card) is affected by quick. The attack is still affected by ranged attack buffs such as sharp sight and range. I may rework this categorization in the future if it's confusing.

[*]Slice and dice (Melee Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/30b0138d4b8a19d21ad48cbdf2f108a75f0c8749.png[/img]
When playing this card, the enemy is knocked back, and the player follows them (up to 3 tiles). This behavior is likely too specific to require its own keyword, but I'm not sure if the effect is clear from the description alone.

[*]Strategic adjustment (Move)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/4cb756dbcfe4c1b47f07ec4b3e2b44ffc4db0c89.png[/img]
This card may feel too weak as a 1-cost, I may reduce it to 0 if this is the case.

[*]Triple toss (Ranged Attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786039/c159dc865a9513cafd0d7383cdd2f41d19e1c28f.png[/img]
This card may also feel too weak/niche in most situations, I may end up increasing the damage, or adding piercing.
[/list]

Keep in mind the damage, range, and costs of these cards may be subject to change depending on balancing ideas and community feedback.

Some additional new features:
[list]
[*]You can hover over some traits to see highlights that show what they do a bit better.
[*]Most of the traits have added responsiveness (eg. color changes when they activate) so that they are more noticeable.
[*]An icon will now pop up, then fade away when a unit receives a buff or debuff, along with the existing UI beside the unit.
[/list]

Smaller tweaks, changes, and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where buffs/debuffs would not return to the correct position when removed
[*]Fixed a bug where slowed enemies did not move (slow will only reduce an enemy's move distance to 1, not 0)
[*]Strength and sharp sight decrease by one each turn until returning to 0 (when negative, increases up to 0)
[*]Changed knight enemy's self-buff strength gain from 2 to 3
[*]Changed the wording of some card descriptions to be clearer/more consistent
[/list]

For the next update, I’ll be looking to add some new enemies and possibly updating the functionality of some of the existing ones. I also want to implement a tooltip system for keywords and buffs in cards, to make them easier to understand for new players, and I'm always coming up with new card ideas.

Thank you for playtesting!

notes.title: Patch - January 23 2022
notes.content:
This is Cardstock's first official patch, thank you to everyone who gave feedback and helped report bugs!

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mouse movement/point and click movement is now implemented for non-combat movement. As with most new features, despite my testing there may be bugs associated with this. Thanks in advance to those that help find them.
[*] Pressing space now resets the camera back to the player
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The floating balls of fire in rooms now have lantern enclosures to reduce confusion
[*] Updated description of Momentous Blow for clarity
[*] Changed position of grey background grid & ground to align with room tiles
[*] Slightly increased spawn rate of shops
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where reward items could be selected more than once
[*] Changed spawning algorithm so that (hopefully) enemies can't spawn inside player
[*] Fixed bug where rotating the camera during transitions would cause jumps
[/list]

notes.title: Cardstock Playtest now open!
notes.content:
The playtest for Cardstock is now public and open, anyone can sign up and try the game for free. 
Currently, Windows is the only supported operating system, but support for others is coming soon!

Although I have tried my best to fix most of the bugs before release of this playtest, some may still occur. If you do encounter any bugs, please let me know on the community hub.

Hopefully this playtest gives you an idea how what the game is going to look like. If you have any suggestions or criticisms, feel free to let me know, that's what this playtest is here for!

Enjoy playing!
